name: agent-worker

bundle.note: FL-9's GUARD (BOB, 2026-09-10, answering DIST's DELEGATION). This member deliberately had NO build step: wrangler.jsonc recorded that the SOURCE deploys, because a committed bundle is a second place its version lives and an artifact that can drift from its source. That objection is ANSWERED rather than overruled — the recipe lives in bio-plane/scripts/fleet-bundle.mjs, the committed manifest beside the artifact states its sha256 and the sha256 of every input, and bio-plane/test/fleetbundles.test.mjs FAILS on a stale artifact rather than letting it ship. The forcing fact is DIST's: `newgroup` is a Worker, it cannot run wrangler or bundle, and this member is THREE modules, so a one-part upload cannot resolve them. This member still depends on NOTHING from npm; the build resolves esbuild from the plane's install.

note: The fleet-coverage marker (D-117). scripts/coverage.mjs discovers a fleet member by this file, reads its `surface` table from `entry`, and holds it to the same surfaces the plane is held to: each surface op reached by a suite in `testDir`, a declared negative control, and fleet rule 2 (no surface op may declare `mutating: true` — a member ASSERTS nothing). scripts/battery.mjs discovers members by this file too and RUNS their suites, because a member whose suite nothing executes is a component going dark while the coverage figure holds still. HIDING THIS FILE DOES NOT HIDE THE MEMBER: coverage.mjs cross-checks every directory carrying a wrangler.jsonc, so a Worker with no manifest FAILS --strict instead of quietly shrinking the fleet.
